description: ETHOS.HiSim is a Python simulator developed by Forschungszentrum Jülich and Hochschule Emden/Leer for household infrastructure and building systems. It connects occupancy, weather, building, photovoltaic, battery, heat-pump, vehicle and thermal-storage components to model demand, generation and control. Separate YAML files describe the physical system and simulation period, time step and requested post-processing. Outputs are time-resolved results and configured plots in a run directory. Coverage is globally configurable, with documented household examples spanning a day or year at quarter-hour or minute resolution. Public source and installation instructions are free under MIT, with Python 3.11 or newer required. A limitation is component-specific input and service requirements: online UTSP occupancy generation needs credentials, while predefined and local modes avoid that dependency. Component connections and input assumptions must be checked for each configuration. HiSim can compare household electrification and flexibility scenarios, complementary to EnergyPlus (model-energyplus). The repository explains example runs and configuration inspection commands. No external credentials, profiles or simulation output were accessed.
